svg.aria-label: Architecture in four regions, left to right. Four source lanes (news, clinical trial registries, patents, commercial reference data) each take their own processing path: news is extracted into atomic assertions, recognized, resolved, consolidated into events and dated; trials load as records; patents run a classify and summarize lane; reference data is mapped and compared beside the news, never merged. Everything lands in a canonical substrate where documents back assertions, assertions consolidate into events, and events build development programs defined by asset, indication and sponsor, linked to canonical entities, with provenance, confidence, temporal state and revision history. Intelligence products answer what changed, who is developing what, what we know about a program, why we believe it, and let other tools ask. An analyst resolution workbench handles only uncertain matches and feeds corrections back. A continuous loop covers incremental ingestion, event revisions and changes since last review.
